overtimeQuestion: Hey, checking up on progress? {{buildingName}} is still being built. Want me to work overtime? {{fee}}g will cut the remaining time in half - or if there's just one day left, it'll be done today!
overtimeYes: Take the money, hurry it up
reducedTime: Robin took {{fee}}g. {{buildingName}}'s remaining construction time is halved!

cfg.fee-multiplier.tooltip: Overtime fee = building (or upgrade) build cost x this multiplier. Default 2.0.
